ownership.reasoning: Celsius Holdings' own September 2025 release names it the owner of Alani Nu and a dated August 2026 article confirms the April 2025 acquisition, which outweighs the undated-profile 'Type: Private' label on the LinkedIn company page.

reporting.note: From Celsius Holdings, Inc.'s quarterly reporting, which breaks out Alani Nu.

summary.text: Alani Nu is a wellness and energy drink brand founded in 2018 by Katy Hearn Schneider and Haydn Schneider, previously operated by Congo Brands.
Celsius Holdings (Nasdaq: CELH) completed its $1.8 billion acquisition of Alani Nu in April 2025 and now owns it as a wholly owned subsidiary.
Alani Nu surpassed $1 billion in trailing 52-week retail sales as of April 2025 and moved into PepsiCo's US and Canadian distribution system in August 2025.
Marketing for Alani Nu sits under Celsius Holdings' leadership, including CMO Rishi Daing, Chief Brand Officer Kyle Watson and Chief Creative Officer JoBeth Fink, who came over from Alani Nu.
The brand runs frequent seasonal drops, including the fall 2026 Witch's Brew return with Ruby Apple and its first energy elixir, Voodoo Vanilla, plus a holiday Sugar Shoppe merch collection.
Products are sold through Target, Amazon, GNC, The Vitamin Shoppe, Kroger, QuikTrip and alaninu.com.
Alani Nu is an energy drink brand in the portfolio of Nasdaq-listed Celsius Holdings (CELH), led by Chairman and CEO John Fieldly.
In Q3 2026 Alani Nu revenue rose about 24% to $410.1 million, with retail sales up 57.9% and a 9.8% U.S. RTD energy dollar share.
Year-to-date 2026 Alani Nu revenue grew about 80% to $1,142.6 million, helped by PepsiCo DSD distribution and the record Witch's Brew LTO.
Core Alani Nu retail sales grew about 50% excluding Witch's Brew, and the brand plans select international launches in 2027.
